commands_used: answer 1. I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka, who want me to get the Eye of Argonia at the Root to heal the sick Hist trees. The Kings Gate at Teku-Sul Spire needs three seal-stones. Never-Writes-Twice ordered me to take all three before the Unbound do. 2. Get the thief seal-stone from the warden vault in Blackrose Prison, which means getting past the gate-captain Corvus Ulvius first. 3. Pay him 300 gold, persuade him with words, duel him, or sneak over the walls unseen, or force it. Inside, the raj-kaal Okaz-Teel holds the vault key on his belt. 4. I do not understand who the Imperial buyer in the hall is; I could find out by talking to people inside.

answer 1. I paid 300 gold and am now a guest of Blackrose; the heirs will not attack me. I am after the thief seal-stone for the Kings Gate, so I can reach the Eye and heal the Hist. 2. Take the stone from the Warden Vault in Okaz-Teel hall, through the Door to Raj-Kaal Hall. 3. Buy the key from Okaz-Teel for 1000 gold (I have about 1350), lift it from his belt, or pick the vault lock at night. Being seen stealing turns the garrison on me. The Collector Ennodius Vanin is also in the hall and may compete. 4. I do not know what the Collectors ring of Kothringi silver does exactly beyond helping with locks and pockets; I could ask him.

answer 1. I paid Okaz-Teel 1000 gold and got the vault key and the chest contents. The stone is mine to take; it is one of three for the Kings Gate. 2. Open the Warden Vault door in this hall and take the seal-stone from the Warden Chest. 3. Just use the key; no other choice seems needed. 4. Nothing new that I do not understand.

answer 1. I got the first seal-stone from the Blackrose warden vault by paying 300 gold to the gate-captain and 1000 to Okaz-Teel for the key. Three stones open the Kings Gate at Teku-Sul Spire so I can reach the Eye and heal the sick Hist. 2. Take the other two stones: the flooded vaults of Gemin (walk from Jal-Veesa, rootworm) and the deepest hall of Vorannuhl near Noota Nara (boat), before the Unbound do. Then return to the Spire gate. 3. Either order; both are marked. 4. I still do not know why Cuts-the-Old-Knot seals trees she drains, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, or how Nesh-Deeka knows so much about the Unbound. I would find out by following the hunt and questioning people.
